implemented_requirements.requirement: Player ship can move horizontally at the bottom of the screen
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.update() reads keyboard state and adjusts self.rect.x, clamping to screen bounds.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can fire shots with a cooldown
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.shoot(now_ms) creates a Bullet when the cooldown has elapsed.
Game.create_aliens() loops over settings.ALIEN_ROWS (4) and settings.ALIEN_COLS (8) adding Alien instances.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player has a limited number of lives
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.lives is initialised from settings.PLAYER_START_LIVES and decremented in Player.hit().
Game.__init__ creates self.score, but no code updates it or renders it.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when aliens reach the bottom or all aliens are destroyed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.state variable exists, but there is no logic that checks alien positions, detects victory, or switches to a game‑over screen.

critical_issues: Game class is missing handle_events, update, and draw methods referenced in run(); calling run() will raise AttributeError.
No collision detection between bullets and aliens or player, so hits are never processed.
Aliens never move as there is no code that changes the formation direction or drops them.
Score is never incremented when an alien is destroyed.
No rendering of HUD elements (score, lives) and no end‑game screens.
The script likely crashes immediately due to the missing methods, making execution unlikely.
judge.summary: The repository contains basic sprite definitions and a Game skeleton that creates the player, aliens, and a main loop, but the core gameplay loop, collision handling, alien movement, scoring, and end‑game conditions are absent. Consequently the implementation does not satisfy the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to run successfully.
